text: The recipe's worked example scores every paired pass and reads its change RMSD of 0.3823 m as about four times the product's stated precision. On the same 50 pairs, two passes carry 0.912 of the summed squared departure from the median difference (LOOK-004): 2024-10-30 (reach_q 2, wse_u 0.095 m, 1.776 m low, the year's lowest stage) and 2024-03-26 (reach_q 1, wse_u 0.296 m, dark_frac 0.692, 0.947 m high). With reach_q below 2 the change RMSD is 0.1859 m; with wse_u below 0.2 m as well it is 0.1051 m and the residual scatter (0.0815 m) is below the median stated uncertainty (0.0957 m) (LOOK-005, LOOK-010). The recipe's numbers are reproduced exactly (LOOK-003); what it lacks is any word on quality screening and on what reach_q values mean for a river reach. No page in the bundle says either. Seen on data already looked at: a lead for the steward, not a correction.
from: an exploration: what it says was seen while exploring and is not a tested claim
